note: Rejudged independently against RFC 4724 Section 4.2: "In re-establishing the session, the "Restart State" bit in the Graceful Restart Capability of the OPEN message sent by the Receiving Speaker MUST NOT be set unless the Receiving Speaker has restarted." TestRFC4724OpenOutsideTheRestartWindowClearsRestartState parses OPEN after cold-start and expired deadlines and asserts R clear with Restart Time 120. Its opposite, TestRFC4724OpenInsideTheRestartWindowSetsRestartState, parses the same configured payload inside the restart window and asserts R set, Time 120 and the unchanged IPv4/unicast tuple, so a producer that never sets R does not pass the pair. The test-only wire view still invokes the production Peer.pluginCapabilitySnapshot and restartFlagsFor; buildOpenFromSnapshot encodes that captured offer. The supplementary grmarker units prove the R-bit edit and preservation of the caller's unmodified payload, not the runtime window gate. The fixture adaptation and helper-comment correction preserve the original test inputs, tags and assertions. Discrimination freshness is checked separately by the main thread; this rejudgment makes no new execution claim.
